apps.name: Fluxa
apps.subtitle: Your media, in one place.
apps.versionDescription:
## What's Changed

- feat(core): add mediainfo conversion, prober trait and CLI prober (`033b12bc`)
- fix(core): return each results as a list so join controls the separator (`8016f00b`)
- feat(core): add track object lists with where, pluck and each to the formatter (`1a83e992`)
- feat(core): convert ffprobe output into probed track data (`ca951b28`)
- feat(core): add probed track data with track filters and mediaInfoQuality (`ef39c779`)
- feat(core): add fetch group orchestration with conditions and dynamic exit (`31470e31`)
- feat(core): add runtime-agnostic join_all future (`4ba85029`)
- feat(core): apply pin and passthrough effects from every expression kind (`4ab138c2`)
- feat(core): add addon stream fetching over an injected transport (`e46173e7`)
- feat(core): add stream expression language and expression-based filters (`2d37aa73`)
- feat(artwork): stream GIF, WebP, APNG and video into one texture and animate the profile background (`d0a3a97c`)
- feat(settings): add a keyframes-only seek preview toggle (`3a9d3026`)
- feat(core): add fluxa-aggmeta metadata aggregator (`c11f4efe`)
- feat(core): add fluxa-streamkit stream parsing, filtering and formatting (`1ad27c31`)
- feat: add session log file and Report a problem form (`0353d340`)
- feat(desktop): open the stream picker as a centered modal with download and copy buttons (`f9114231`)
- feat(desktop): show the resumed episode's synopsis and image in the Continue Watching preview (`aefdc6a9`)
